claim: The CLI demo creates a complete sample in a new isolated folder.
where: README, CLI help, landing terminal transcript
sandbox: new temp parent; run demo twice; assert separate paths, manifests, inherited inspection, checklist, and safe existing-path refusal

claim: Init writes deterministic schema-v1 JSON with explicit editor profiles and observed extensions.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; create a sample RAF folder; run init with two mappings twice; compare parsed fields and exact bytes

claim: CLI operations do not change photos or editor sidecars.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; hash its photo and added sidecar fixtures before and after init, inspect, and checklist; assert only requested outputs appear

claim: Inspect reports whether the current folder or nearest parent supplied the recipe file and its source path.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; add a deeper folder and nearer override; assert inheritance, current-folder state, level count, and source path

claim: Checklist export produces one sorted row per folder with a recipe file.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; export its two recipe folders twice; assert count, sort order, mappings, and deterministic output

claim: Commands are non-interactive and use exit codes 0 for success, 2 for invalid input, and 1 for I/O failure.
sandbox: fresh temp folder; close stdin; exercise successful demo, missing input, and write-to-directory failure under timeout

claim: Schema version 1 accepts unknown fields and unsupported schema versions fail clearly.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; inspect a recipe with an unknown object then schema version 2; assert output and exit 2 message

claim: Folder Recipe runs locally without a network connection.
sandbox: fresh temp folder; preload socket/connect denial shim; run complete demo; assert success and zero blocked network calls

claim: The build creates the release binary and deployable static site.
sandbox: clean build and demo run performed by claim runner; assert one binary plus landing, demo, legal, 404, and service-worker artifacts

claim: Folder Recipe records profile choices but does not edit photos, apply profiles, or manage an editor catalogue.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; inspect CLI help; assert demo, init, inspect, and checklist but no edit, apply, or catalogue command

claim: The first-screen browser demo loads sample profiles in one click, saves nothing, resets, and offers a real start.
sandbox: fresh browser context from landing; click demo; assert URL, banner, ready sample, reset, exit link, and empty local/session storage

claim: The browser checker keeps selected recipe files in memory and contacts only this site.
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept complete demo and selected-file flow; assert same-origin requests, no cookies, local/session storage, or IndexedDB

claim: The demo and recipe checker work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load demo until controlled, set offline, reload, reset sample, and assert checked recipe

claim: Folder Recipe is free under the MIT License and has no account or payment path.
sandbox: run demo in a fresh temp parent; assert MIT license text, no account/payment form or provider route, and matching terms copy
